Ooredoo الجزائر تُثري عرضها المسبق الدفع: Ooredoo Algeria enriches its prepaid offer "Ooredoo"
تواصل Ooredoo الجزائر تحسين عروضها التجا: Ooredoo Algeria continues to improve its commercial offers by developing its prepaid offer "Ooredoo", through the introduction of new bundles and the enrichment of the benefits offered to its customers, aiming to grant them more internet and calls according to their usage and needs.
يندرج هذا التطوير ضمن حرص Ooredoo على تق: This development is part of Ooredoo's commitment to providing bundles that are more suited to various consumption patterns, by offering larger internet volumes, additional communication benefits, and enriching the available bundles, allowing each customer to choose the bundle that suits their needs.
يتوفر عرض «Ooredoo» على خمس فئات:: The "Ooredoo" offer is available in five categories:
Ooredoo 1000 دج : يمنح 15 جيغا اوكتي من: Ooredoo 1000 DZD: Grants 15 GB of internet, a credit of 2000 DZD towards all national networks, and unlimited calls to Ooredoo, valid for 4 weeks.
Ooredoo 1500 دج : يمنح 40 جيغا اوكتي من: Ooredoo 1500 DZD: Grants 40 GB of internet, a credit of 3000 DZD towards all national networks, and unlimited calls to Ooredoo, valid for 4 weeks.
Ooredoo 2000 دج : يمنح 90 جيغا اوكتي من: Ooredoo 2000 DZD: Grants 90 GB of internet, unlimited calls to all networks, unlimited SMS to Ooredoo and 50 SMS to other networks, valid for 4 weeks.
Ooredoo 2500 دج : يمنح 120 جيغا اوكتي من: Ooredoo 2500 DZD: Grants 120 GB of internet, in addition to unlimited calls and SMS to all networks, valid for 30 days.
Ooredoo 4000 دج : يتيح الاستفادة من 220: Ooredoo 4000 DZD: Allows the benefit of 220 GB of internet, in addition to unlimited calls and SMS to all networks, valid for 30 days.
إضافة لهذه المزايا، تُثري Ooredoo عرضها: In addition to these benefits, Ooredoo also enriches its offer with long-term subscription formulas for customers wishing to optimize their consumption according to the duration of their choice. By subscribing for 6, 9, or 12 months, customers benefit respectively from one, two, or three free months, while maintaining the flexibility of the prepaid offer.
للاطلاع على الباقات المتاحة واختيار البا: To view the available bundles and choose the one that suits them or activate it, customers can access the Ooredoo application via the following link https://ore.do/on-b or dial the code *500#.
من خلال اثراء عرضها المسبق الدفع، تؤكد O: By enriching its prepaid offer, Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its commitment to providing communication solutions that meet the expectations of its customers, while granting them more choices and flexibility in their daily lives.
